observed_reality.wal_policy_candidate: draft PR 460 classifies SQLite release families by sqlite3.sqlite_version and selects WAL for fixed families, DELETE for vulnerable families

primary_upstream_evidence.finding: the WAL-reset defect affects upstream releases through 3.51.2 and is fixed in 3.51.3 plus documented backports; SQLite 3.53.4 is later than that fix boundary
primary_upstream_evidence.scope_limit: upstream version-family safety does not attest which binary object the productive Frank process actually loaded

grf.generated_reality: If a runtime reports a fixed SQLite semantic version, the WAL policy gate is sufficient evidence to treat the productive runtime as release-trusted.
grf.counter_reality: A byte-distinct or otherwise unattested SQLite object can report the same fixed semantic version; a version-family gate can correctly classify the upstream bug boundary while still being unable to establish artifact or mapped-object authority.
grf.discriminator: Apply the exact PR 460 version parsing/classification semantics to an accepted-looking 3.53.4 label and to a decorated/unattested 3.53.4-counterfeit label, then compare the decision boundary with the separate V5/V6 artifact/mapped-object gates.
grf.architecture_consequence: Keep bug-family policy, artifact authority, mapped-object identity, root-secure provisioning, production start-path non-bypassability, and restart/rollback continuity as separate compositional gates. Do not let any one substitute for the others.

exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.name: FIXED_VERSION_WITHOUT_ARTIFACT_ATTESTATION
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.scope: disposable local logic-level reproduction of PR 460 version classifier; no production or canonical state mutation
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.interpretation: The classifier correctly separates vulnerable upstream version families, but deliberately cannot distinguish accepted artifact identity from an unattested object presenting an equivalent version label.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.rollback: none required; pure local process exited after output

counterevidence_and_nonclaims.reason: PR 460 already states that exact runtime identity remains a separate acceptance obligation; this experiment confirms the composition boundary rather than falsifying the version-family fallback mechanism.

reentry.next_falsifier: On the accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS, prove the productive Frank start path is non-bypassably admitted through the trusted artifact/root-start gates and that the running process maps the exact accepted SQLite object across clean start, restart, downgrade/library-swap and rollback controls before allowing canonical WAL state.
reentry.promotion_requirement: exact-current accepted-host receipt tying service/start identity, root trust anchor, accepted artifact digest, mapped dev+inode+hash, SQLite source-id/version, canonical state mode, restart continuity and negative downgrade/swap controls into one provenance-bound chain
